## Risk review

Classification: ordinary / risky (explain). Use the [review procedure](https://github.com/johnvanesyan-arch/HaiEdu/blob/main/docs/qa/risky-change-review.md) for migrations/data changes, authorization/tenant boundaries, assessment or content policy, shared runtime changes, and release/security controls.

For a risky change, fill in the following before treating independent review as complete:

- Exact reviewed head SHA:
- Independent reviewer and submitted review URL:
- Invariants, failure cases and affected-consumer evidence:
- Rollback or containment plan and unresolved limits:
- Reviewer disposition and findings resolution:

CI results and author/agent checklists are technical evidence; they are not independent approval. Do not record a reviewer's acceptance on their behalf. An empty field remains pending. Retain separate owner/content/release gates and the explicit BF-02 deferral.
